title: Camp Sidney Dew

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Camp Sidney Dew is the ultimate destination for outdoor adventure and unforgettable experiences for Scouts of all ages. Nestled in the breathtaking Appalachian foothills of Georgia Camp Sidney Dew offers a perfect blend of nature, adventure, and camaraderie. Our experienced staff is dedicated to creating a safe and supportive environment where campers can thrive, learn new skills, make lifelong friends, and create lasting memories. Join us at Camp Sidney Dew and discover a camping experience that will unleash your Scout Spirit and you will see why CSD is the perfect destination for Scouts seeking an unforgetable summer

blurb: Camp Sidney Dew Camping, adventure, and lifelong memories in the great outdoors. Explore Camping Over 85 Years of Scouting Experience Located in the northwest corner of Georgia and approximately 20 miles north of Rome, Camp Sidney Dew offers the natural beauty of the Appalachian foothills.
